messages:
anya: Heads up — last night the SA-gpu pool hit 95% utilisation and PagerBot flooded the whole SRE rotation with pages. We recovered with cross-region traffic shift but we should tweak routing to avoid wake-the-whole-team for capacity-only degradations.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] 2026-02-14 02:14 UTC — region=sa-east1, metric=gpu_utilization, value=95%. Routed to: @sre-rotation, @infra-oncall. Incident ID: INC-20260214-224.

sanjay: Yeah saw that. Two problems: (1) current policy treats any region capacity breach as P1, (2) no staggered escalation when automated failover succeeds.

anya: Proposed change: when auto-failover traffic_shift=true and failover reaches 90%+ of target within 5m, treat as P2 and only page primary oncall + infra lead via SMS if unresolved for 15m. Immediate P1 only if failover fails or error rate increases >2%.

dana: I like that. Also suggest a short "grace window" so we don't page for transient spikes caused by batch jobs. 3m rolling average?

leo: From runbook POV: add step 1.1: "If auto-failover triggered, monitor failover_progress metric. If progress >=90% within 5m, switch escalation to 'degraded-capacity' policy."

onsite-bot: (deploybot) Updated routing config in staging: pagerbot/configs/sa-failover-window.yaml

anya: Sharing the draft config snippet below. This would be the new default for capacity alerts in all non-prod and SA prod regions. Please sanity-check.

```
# pagerbot capacity policy (draft)
match: metric == 'gpu_utilization' && region == 'sa-east1'
threshold: 90
rolling_window: 3m
on_threshold: |
  if auto_failover.triggered and failover_progress >= 90% within 5m:
    severity: P2
    escalate: [primary-oncall, infra-lead]
    sms_after: 15m
  else:
    severity: P1
    escalate: [rotation, paging-policy-all]
```

sanjay: Two nitpicks: (a) sms_after = 15m is fine but add webhook to #eng-oncall-incidents so we get telemetry, (b) include a rate-limit for pages during window: max 1 page per 10m per region.

infra-manager-bot: NOTE: rate_limit=1/10m added to draft. Audit log entry created: audit/1779998888-rl.json

anya: Okay updated draft applied to staging. Next step: run chaos experiment during low-traffic hours to validate no missed real P1s. Volunteers for on-call shadowing?

dana: I can shadow 2026-02-16 01:00-05:00 UTC and monitor both alert routing + rollback triggers.

sanjay: I'll own the experiment plan and rollback criteria. I'll update the runbook and post PR tonight.

leo: Also update the on-call handoff checklist: add a line to confirm the new policy is in effect and that SMS provider creds are valid for infra leads.

anya: Great — plan: Sanjay posts PR, Dana runs chaos test, Leo updates runbook. If experiment passes, we promote staging config to prod next Wednesday off-peak window. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: [INFO] Thread marked for follow-up. Reminder set: 2026-02-16 00:45 UTC (chaos test prep).

infra-manager-bot: [INFO] Escalation policy change will be drafted into CHANGELOG-ops on merge.

anya: thanks all. Will post postmortem-lite after experiment with metrics (pages avoided, mean time to detect, failover success rate).
